scoreNote: Score is the measured win rate in ranked public matches (rank-bracketed only), from OpenDota's rolling ~7 day window. Nothing is simulated and no weights are hand-tuned. Caveat: a high pub win rate means the hero wins more games in ranked matchmaking, not that it is strongest in optimal or professional play. Per-position win rates are not available from any free source, so heroes are grouped by primary attribute, not by position.
